name: Opus Broadening

orders.reason: Germany dead money: -0.5% YTD and -0.8% last month, gave back its 2025 run with no forward momentum
Broad EM rolling over (-6.0% last month), dragged by India -10.7% and China; breadth is now in US, not EM
Mediocre developed-intl (+9.5%, +0.5% 1mo) that overlaps EWJ; keeping Japan as the sole working intl anchor
Large-cap healthcare sluggish (+2.7%, devices IHI -19%); the real healthcare breadth is in biotech
Equal-weight S&P 500 - the definitional anti-concentration anchor that directly under-weights the Mag7
US large-cap value, a pure anti-Mag7 breadth trade with momentum (+17.3% YTD, +10.7% 3mo)
Energy, the strongest laggard-sector participation (+25.5% YTD) and maximally uncorrelated with mega-cap tech
Biotech breadth exploding (+28.7% YTD, +14.6% last month) - the healthcare rotation via innovation, replacing sluggish XLV

outlook: Index concentration remains extreme (memory/AI melt-up), but breadth is genuinely emerging in US small/mid caps, value, financials (rotation accelerating +6% last month) and biotech rather than in international. I rotate out of dead Germany/EM/broad-EAFE and sluggish large-cap healthcare into working US breadth plus energy, keeping Japan and regional banks as the highest-momentum anchors.
